lines.zh: 它把身体一节节推过海沟。
lines.en: It pushes its body through the trench segment by segment.

lines.zh: 它的环节在沙上留下一道沟。
lines.en: Its segments leave a furrow in the sand.

lines.zh: 它从海底的泥里拱出来。
lines.en: It bulges up out of the seabed mud.

lines.zh: 它停下，等暗流把它送近。
lines.en: It stops and lets the current carry it closer.

lines.zh: 它笨重的头先探进岩缝。
lines.en: Its heavy head probes into a rock crevice first.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤在水里泛出灰白。
lines.en: Its hide shows grey-white through the water.

lines.zh: 我半截身子埋在热沙里，只留眼睛。
lines.en: Half my body buried in warm sand, I leave only my eyes out.
Only its head shows above the sand.

lines.zh: 它半埋着，像一段沉船木。
lines.en: Half buried, it looks like wreck timber.

lines.zh: 它闭着眼，随水轻轻起伏。
lines.en: Eyes shut, it rocks gently with the water.
It stays still and waits for you to move first.
It lifts its eyes from the sand to you.

lines.zh: 它在远处绕着你转了一圈。
lines.en: It circles you once at a distance.

lines.zh: 它贴着海床，盯着你的脚。
lines.en: Hugging the seabed, it watches your feet.
Even a worm of hundreds of segments feels pain.
When the arrows stop, I lock up.

lines.zh: 我这条巨虫，先看着你走。
lines.en: I watch you move before this worm strikes.

lines.zh: 我在水里看你，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I circle you in the water, round and round.

lines.zh: 我这一身软壳，撞一下就凹。
lines.en: My soft shell dents at a single bump.

lines.zh: 你的船底顶到我的环节了。
lines.en: Your hull is nudging into my body segments.

lines.zh: 退后，我身上的黏液会缠住你。
lines.en: Back off, the slime on my body will wrap around you.

lines.zh: 我在海沟里听同类的低频鸣叫。
lines.en: In the trench I listen for the low call of my own kind.

lines.zh: 沙底下有另一条长影在回应我。
lines.en: Another long shadow under the sand answers me.

lines.zh: 我要找一条同长的巨虫。
lines.en: I am looking for a worm as long as me.

lines.zh: 海床上的这些东西，我先卷过来。
lines.en: Whatever lies on the seabed, I coil it in first.

lines.zh: 沉船的碎片，我拖回泥里藏好。
lines.en: Wreck splinters I drag back into the mud to keep.

lines.zh: 箭扎在我身上，我会僵一下。
lines.en: Arrows stick in me and I stiffen a moment.

lines.zh: 水里的振动，把你的位置告诉我。
lines.en: The vibration in the water tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 箭能扎进我，可扎不死我。
lines.en: Arrows stick in me, but they don't kill me.
I begin circling from beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 我这条长身子，整片海都装得下。
lines.en: This long body of mine fills the whole sea.

lines.zh: 靠近我，你会被这具长身吞掉。
lines.en: Come close and this long body will swallow you.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我身上，我会顿一下。
lines.en: Arrows stick in me — I pause a moment.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床，一圈一圈收拢。
lines.en: Hugging the seabed, I close the circle ring by ring.

lines.zh: 这条大虫子，先绕你三圈。
lines.en: This giant worm circles you three times first.

lines.zh: 箭扎在壳上，我僵了一下。
lines.en: An arrow in my hide; I froze a moment.

lines.zh: 四百点的身躯，正在水底绕着你转。
lines.en: Four hundred points of worm is circling below.

lines.zh: 我一头拱过去，水都翻起来。
lines.en: I ram forward and the water heaves.

lines.zh: 牙圈咬住你的腿，往深水拖。
lines.en: My ring of teeth clamps your leg and drags you deep.
Four hundred points of flesh, swallowed whole.
I'm the ruler of this sea!

lines.zh: 海面上鼓起一道长长的水脊。
lines.en: A long ridge of water swells across the surface.

lines.zh: 我从最深的泥里直起身子。
lines.en: I rear up out of the deepest mud.

lines.zh: 这片海底的沟，是我拱出来的。
lines.en: This trench on the seabed is one I plowed myself.

lines.zh: 暗流把我的气味送到你船上。
lines.en: The undercurrent carries my scent up to your boat.

lines.zh: 四百点身子的影子，罩住你的船。
lines.en: The shadow of my four hundred points covers your boat.

lines.zh: 我的存在，就是一场盛宴！

lines.en: The seabed splits and it comes through.

lines.zh: 水面下浮起一道长长的影子。
lines.en: A long shadow rises under the surface.

lines.zh: 整条虫身摔下来，砸得发闷。
lines.en: A whole worm's length fell and landed dully.

lines.zh: 海水灌满我每一节身子，沉下去。
lines.en: Seawater fills every segment of me and I sink.

lines.zh: 巨型蠕虫也会被箭钉住一会。
lines.en: Even a giant worm gets pinned by arrows.

lines.zh: 法术攻击打中了我的鳞片！
我从海沟底掉下去，一直往下。
lines.en: I drop off the trench floor and just keep falling.
